view.adventure_description: On still nights, the people of Hollin Ferry hear a bell tolling under the Grey Mere, from the sunken priory on Corvane's Holm. Since it began, the drowned dead have been seen walking on the causeway. An introductory adventure for three to six characters of first level.
view.town_description: A huddle of reed-thatched houses and smokehouses on the shore of the Grey Mere. A flat-bottomed ferry crosses to Corvane's Holm when the ferryman can be paid to go. The temple of the Lantern stands at the top of the street, and its own bell has hung silent since the drowned bell began to toll.
town_services: Ostler's store: weapons, armour, and adventuring gear
Temple of the Lantern: cure light wounds, cure serious wounds, cure disease, neutralize poison, remove curse, and raise dead
Widow Marl, moneychanger: buys gems, jewellery, and coin
The Smoked Eel: beds, hot food, and a quiet corner to study spells

areas.name: Gatehouse stair
areas.description: A flight of worn steps runs down from the roofless gatehouse into the undercroft of the priory. A stone statue of a hooded monk lies face down across the bottom steps, broken at the knees. Lake water drips from the vault, and the air smells of reeds and old smoke. A wide archway opens to the north.

features.description: The statue is Saint Corvane, holding up a lantern. Someone has chipped the glass out of the lantern to see whether there was silver inside it.

journal.text: The ferry grounds at the landing stage of Corvane's Holm. As you step ashore, a bell tolls once, somewhere beneath your feet.
As the ferry grounds, the ferryman tells you about the priory's relic, the Hand of Saint Corvane, lost in the flood. The temple would pay well to have it back.

quests.name: Break the Red Thumbs
quests.narrative: Reeve Tamsin Hale has posted a bounty on the ferry house door: 100 gp for the death of Gashnak One-Ear, the hobgoblin whose goblins rob the ferry and the eel traps.
quests.speaker: Reeve Tamsin Hale

quests.name: The Hand of Saint Corvane

quests.speaker: the ferryman

objectives.name: Return the Hand to the temple

quests.name: Silence the drowned bell
quests.narrative: Mother Aldis asks you to cross to the priory on Corvane's Holm, find the bell that tolls under the water, and bring back its tongue so the temple can melt it down.
quests.speaker: Mother Aldis

objectives.name: Bring the tongue to Hollin Ferry
